question: In skeletal skeletal muscle of mammals:

options.opa: A motor neuron supplies all its fibers.
options.opb: Each motor neuron supplies a single fiber.
options.opc: Each fiber receives innervation from a single motor neuron.
options.opd: Summation of synaptic potentials is required to reach the excitation threshold.

analysis: In skeletal muscle of mammals, each motor neuron supplies multiple muscle fibers, not just a single fiber. This is known as motor unit recruitment. Each muscle fiber receives innervation from a single motor neuron, forming a motor unit. Summation of synaptic potentials is required to reach the excitation threshold for muscle contraction.
